title: Ring Hover Flight (Grip Toggle, Speed/Alt Caps, Energy Drain, Comfort)
description: Adds a hover-flight mode unlocked after tutorial. Holding grip engages hover; thumbstick moves with capped speed and ascent, altitude cap above ground, and optional soft pushback near scene bounds. Applies speed-scaled comfort vignette and drains ring_energy while active. Disabled in no-fly volumes and in indoor scenes. Coexists with teleport and snap turn.
acceptance_notes: Ensure hover only in oa_plaza and within tagged allowed areas. Energy drains continuously; disengages safely at 0. Comfort vignette scales with velocity. Disable in central_battery_chamber and any no_fly volumes. Unlock controlled by tutorial flag.
